title: digitalis × purpurascens var. fucata
intro: Digitalis × purpurascens var. fucata, commonly known as a hybrid foxglove, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as improved heart function, increased cardiac output, and enhanced circulation, making it a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis × purpurascens var. fucata include positive inotropic effects, which increase the force of heart muscle contractions, and negative chronotropic effects, which decrease the frequency of heartbeats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardiac glycosides, such as digoxin and digitoxin, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
